transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, um... I guess what brings me in is just this feeling I've been having lately. I've been waking up with this really heavy, hollow kind of sadness. I'm a choreographer, and lately it feels like... like the studio lights are on, but there's just no music in me anymore. I just feel really down.
About how long have you been feeling this heavy sadness?
I'd say this depressed feeling has been going on for about nine months now. It's just been a steady, heavy presence since then.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, elated, or 'on top of the world'?

Yeah, um... I have. There were stretches a while back where I felt just... dazzlingly alive. Like I had endless energy. But it wasn't always just a good feeling. I would get suddenly furious if anyone questioned the plan I was making, or if they tried to remind me that my ankle still needed rest. I just felt so energized, but really irritable if anyone pushed back on what I wanted to do.
During those times when you felt that surge of energy and irritability, about how long would that state typically last?

Um... I'm not really sure, to be honest. When I get like that, I don't really keep track of time very well. I wasn't paying attention to the calendar or anything, so I couldn't give you an exact timeframe.
During those high-energy times, did it cause significant problems or disruption in your work or personal relationships?

Yeah, it definitely did. Um... my studio got really chaotic. I fell behind on my teaching prep and actually missed a grant deadline because of it. It got bad enough that my collaborators started handling basic scheduling for me just to keep things running. I mean, even lately, I’m still showing up for the bare essentials, but... I’m just not functioning like I normally do as a choreographer or a teacher.
During those high-energy times, did you find that you needed much less sleep than usual to feel fully rested?

Yeah, my sleep has really been all over the place. Back during those energized times, I didn't need much... some nights I just stayed up sketching out dance formations until dawn and felt fine. But lately, it's been different. Now I fall asleep totally exhausted, but I end up waking at four or five in the morning with my stomach feeling really tight.
